Integration uses -fno-exceptions (HNSWLIB_ENABLE_EXCEPTIONS=OFF) and Status-returning NoExceptions APIs.
Prefetch disabled using upstream HNSWLIB_USE_PREFETCH=0: GCC15 ASan detected an out-of-bounds neighbor lookahead read in searchBaseLayer with the default SSE prefetch path. Regression suite covers 2000 inserts.
